segment.source: Sorry, $(#sir/ma'am), but I can't let you in.<end>
segment.target: Sorry, $(#sir/ma'am), but I can't let you in.<end>

segment.source:
::The soldier quirks an eyebrow as he examines your security pass.::
So... your name is Bob then? That's a strange name for a woman.<end>
segment.target:
::The soldier quirks an eyebrow as he examines your security pass.::
So... your name is Bob then? That's a strange name for a woman.<end>

segment.source: ::[Persuade]:: Oops, it seems I accidentally swapped my security pass with Bob.<end>
segment.target: ::[Persuade]:: Oops, it seems I accidentally swapped my security pass with Bob.<end>

segment.source: And what would your name be?<end>
segment.target: And what would your name be?<end>

segment.source: $(context.player.Name).<end>
segment.target: $(context.player.Name).<end>

segment.source: Nice try, but no one by that name works here. You're coming with me. ::He aims his weapon at you.::<end>
segment.target: Nice try, but no one by that name works here. You're coming with me. ::He aims his weapon at you.::<end>

segment.source: Wait, I am one of you guys. Corporal $(context.player.Name). Stationed at Fort Apogee.<end>
segment.target: Wait, I am one of you guys. Corporal $(context.player.Name). Stationed at Fort Apogee.<end>

segment.source: Shut up and put your hands in the air, zoner!<end>
segment.target: Shut up and put your hands in the air, zoner!<end>

segment.source: ::Resist arrest.::<end>
segment.target: ::Resist arrest.::<end>

segment.source: Kate Johnson.<end>
segment.target: Kate Johnson.<end>

segment.source: Tina Miller.<end>
segment.target: Tina Miller.<end>

segment.source: Doris Davis.<end>
segment.target: Doris Davis.<end>

segment.source: Mary Scott.<end>
segment.target: Mary Scott.<end>

segment.source: Never mind. I think I got the wrong building. Bye.<end>
segment.target: Never mind. I think I got the wrong building. Bye.<end>

segment.source: I don't think so. You're coming with me. ::He aims his weapon at you.::<end>
segment.target: I don't think so. You're coming with me. ::He aims his weapon at you.::<end>

segment.source: ::Fight!::<end>
segment.target: ::Fight!::<end>

segment.source: Nice try, but you're coming with me. ::He aims his weapon at you.::<end>
segment.target: Nice try, but you're coming with me. ::He aims his weapon at you.::<end>

segment.source: It's short for Kate.<end>
segment.target: It's short for Kate.<end>

segment.source: You're one dumb zoner, aren't you? You're coming with me. ::He aims his weapon at you.::<end>
segment.target: You're one dumb zoner, aren't you? You're coming with me. ::He aims his weapon at you.::<end>

segment.source: I think I got the wrong building. Excuse me.<end>
segment.target: I think I got the wrong building. Excuse me.<end>

segment.source: ::Attack.::<end>
segment.target: ::Attack.::<end>

segment.source: You're late again, Bob. <end>
segment.target: You're late again, Bob. <end>

segment.source: And since when are you a marine?<end>
segment.target: And since when are you a marine?<end>

segment.source: ::[Persuade]:: I had a bad day, man, just let me go inside before the commander notices.<end>
segment.target: ::[Persuade]:: I had a bad day, man, just let me go inside before the commander notices.<end>

segment.source: Oh, he noticed already. He ordered that you report to him immediately. ::He speaks into his comm device and after a few moments the doors unlock.::<end>
segment.target: Oh, he noticed already. He ordered that you report to him immediately. ::He speaks into his comm device and after a few moments the doors unlock.::<end>

segment.source: Good luck, man.<end>
segment.target: Good luck, man.<end>

segment.source: ::He looks at you suspiciously.:: You are not Bob. You're coming with me! ::He aims his weapon at you.::<end>
segment.target: ::He looks at you suspiciously.:: You are not Bob. You're coming with me! ::He aims his weapon at you.::<end>

segment.source: This... is temporary. I left my armor inside.<end>
segment.target: This... is temporary. I left my armor inside.<end>

segment.source: No you didn't...<end>
segment.target: No you didn't...<end>

segment.source: And why aren't you in your uniform?<end>
segment.target: And why aren't you in your uniform?<end>

segment.source: I left it inside.<end>
segment.target: I left it inside.<end>

segment.source: <end>
segment.target: <end>

segment.source: ::The soldier quirks and eyebrow as he examines your security pass.:: Say, Bob... There's something different about you today.<end>
segment.target: ::The soldier quirks and eyebrow as he examines your security pass.:: Say, Bob... There's something different about you today.<end>

segment.source: Can't quite put my finger on it. You're just looking a bit...<end>
segment.target: Can't quite put my finger on it. You're just looking a bit...<end>

segment.source: ...pale today.<end>
segment.target: ...pale today.<end>

segment.source: ::He aims his weapon at you.:: Alright, buster, the jig is up.<end>
segment.target: ::He aims his weapon at you.:: Alright, buster, the jig is up.<end>

segment.source: Move along, citizen. This is a restricted area.<end>
segment.target: Move along, citizen. This is a restricted area.<end>

segment.source: Aren't you going to salute me, soldier?<end>
segment.target: Aren't you going to salute me, soldier?<end>

segment.source: Salute you? Who are you?<end>
segment.target: Salute you? Who are you?<end>

segment.source: I am Corporal $(context.player.Name) and I need to get inside.<end>
segment.target: I am Corporal $(context.player.Name) and I need to get inside.<end>

segment.source: Yeah? On whose orders?<end>
segment.target: Yeah? On whose orders?<end>

segment.source: Colonel Cathcart himself sent me here to perform an inspection.<end>
segment.target: Colonel Cathcart himself sent me here to perform an inspection.<end>

segment.source: Well, I wasn't informed anyone by that name was supposed to arrive. So I can't let you in. Orders.<end>
segment.target: Well, I wasn't informed anyone by that name was supposed to arrive. So I can't let you in. Orders.<end>

segment.source: But I am a corporal. I have a higher rank.<end>
segment.target: But I am a corporal. I have a higher rank.<end>

segment.source: Listen, $(#sir/ma'am), I am going to talk slower now: I... cannot... let... you... in. $(#Sir/Ma'am).<end>
segment.target: Listen, $(#sir/ma'am), I am going to talk slower now: I... cannot... let... you... in. $(#Sir/Ma'am).<end>

segment.source: May I speak to your commanding officer?<end>
segment.target: May I speak to your commanding officer?<end>

segment.source: To Captain Wilkins?<end>
segment.target: To Captain Wilkins?<end>

segment.source: Yes.<end>
segment.target: Yes.<end>

segment.source: No.<end>
segment.target: No.<end>

segment.source: Very good. Carry on, soldier.<end>
segment.target: Very good. Carry on, soldier.<end>

segment.source: I will, $(#sir/ma'am). Um... ::He salutes you.::<end>
segment.target: I will, $(#sir/ma'am). Um... ::He salutes you.::<end>

segment.source: ::Leave.::<end>
segment.target: ::Leave.::<end>
